") center/cover no-repeat;
}
#loginScreen:before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,8,48,.30),rgba(0,10,56,.05),rgba(0,8,48,.24));
  pointer-events:none;
}
.login-wrap{
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  width:min(560px,100%);
  text-align:center;color:white;
}
.login-logo{
  width:175px;height:175px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;
  box-shadow:0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}
.login-title{
  margin:14px 0 0;font-size:52px;line-height:1;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.3px;
  text-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.28)
}
.login-subtitle{margin:8px 0 20px;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:6px}
.login-card{
  width:min(510px,100%);margin:auto;padding:28px 30px 24px;
  border-radius:28px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);color:var(--text);
  box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,45,.30);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85)
}
.input-shell{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:60px;margin-bottom:13px;padding:0 18px;
  border:1px solid #d5dce8;border-radius:20px;background:#fbfcff
}
.input-shell .icon{width:26px;font-size:20px;color:#132a69}
.input-shell input{
  width:100%;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;font-size:16px;color:#17213c
}
.login-btn{
  width:100%;height:61px;border:0;border-radius:20px;margin-top:4px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#98d620,#bee64b);color:#061b72;font-weight:950;font-size:19px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(126,181,24,.25)
}
.login-help{margin:15px auto 0;max-width:390px;color:#59657b;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.45}
.login-error{min-height:18px;margin-top:8px;color:#b42318;font-weight:800;font-size:13px}
.login-features{
  display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:0;margin:24px auto 0;max-width:500px
}
.login-feature{flex:1;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);padding:0 12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.3}
.login-feature:last-child{border-right:0}
.login-feature .fi{display:block;color:#b7e334;font-size:24px;margin-bottom:6px}
.login-feature b{font-size:13px}
.brandline{margin-top:22px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:4px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.admin-link{
  position:absolute;z-index:3;right:22px;bottom:20px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.38);background:rgba(4,22,88,.42);color:#fff;
  border-radius:999px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)
}
.admin-modal{
  position:absolute;z-index:5;right:22px;bottom:66px;width:min(330px,calc(100vw - 28px));
  background:#fff;color:var(--text);border-radius:18px;padding:18px;text-align:left;
  box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.28)
}
.admin-modal h3{margin:0 0 12px}
.admin-modal input{width:100%;padding:11px;border:1px solid #ccd4e1;border-radius:10px}
.admin-modal .row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.admin-modal-msg{min-height:18px;color:var(--red);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;margin-top:7px}

/* ---------- APP SHELL ---------- */
#appHeader{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 16px;
  color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),#07105c);
  box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,20,80,.18)
}
#appHeader img{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%}
#appHeader .brand b{display:block;font-size:18px}
#appHeader .brand small{opacity:.78}
#appHeader .spacer{flex:1}
.small-btn{border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.13);color:#fff;font-weight:800}
